title: Elah (king of Israel)
summary: King of the northern kingdom of Israel, son of Baasha. Jones dates his accession.
description: King of the northern kingdom of Israel, son of Baasha. Jones dates his accession. Appendix F prints no end year, so no span is stored.

sorting_basis.note: Sorted by reign start (Ussher–Jones). No tier 1–4 birth year. The year is the reign-start figure already printed on dates.reign: 3074 930 Elah becomes king over Israel.

reign.citation: Jones, The Chronology of the Old Testament: A Return to the Basics, 23rd ed. (Master Books, 2026), Appendix F, printed p. 279 (PDF p. 314)
reign.note: Appendix F prints no end year, so no span is stored.

reign.date: To Baasha succeeded Ela his sonne, who at a feast at his Palace of Thersa, was in his cups slaine by Zambris after he had reigned two yeeres
reign.citation: Raleigh, The History of the World (1617, EEBO-TCP A10357), Book II, Part I, Chapter IX, §. II, sig. 238a
reign.note: Body intake. His two yeeres. The Catalogue in §. III prints 20. See N66. Not a yeere of the World. year_am stays null. This does not change the sort.
